title: Bridge stack summaries collapse triggered abilities into generic player-targeted "Ability"
description:
Triggered abilities in `pass_priority` / `get_action_choices` lose their source card and rules text, so the prompt stack summary degenerates to `Ability -> {'name': 'Player (you)', 'id': 'p2'}` instead of telling the model which ability is resolving.

In `game_20260309_012143_g2`, Gem3P Coach cast Emancipation Angel. XMage/bridge chat correctly announced the trigger source and text, but the next `choose_action` response only exposed `message="Select a permanent you control"` and `stack=[{"name":"Ability","targets":[{"name":"Gem3P Coach (you)","id":"p2"}]}]`. Gemini then tried `choice="p53"` (`Unknown short ID`) and later `choice="p2"` (`Object p2 not found in current choices`) before eventually finding the intended bounce target.

Evidence:
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_012143_g2/Gem3P Coach_bridge.jsonl:547` shows the real trigger: Emancipation Angel ETB returning a permanent you control.
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_012143_g2/Gem3P Coach_llm.jsonl:117` shows the lossy target prompt with `stack=[{"name":"Ability",...}]`.
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_012143_g2/Gem3P Coach_llm.jsonl:128` and `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_012143_g2/Gem3P Coach_llm.jsonl:132` show the resulting bad target attempts.
- `website/public/games/game_20260309_012143_g2.json:35680`, `website/public/games/game_20260309_012143_g2.json:35972`, and `website/public/games/game_20260309_012143_g2.json:36264` still have the correct exported stack item name and `source_card: Emancipation Angel`, so the raw game state was available.

Source:
- `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeCallbackHandler.java:769` builds stack summaries with `safeDisplayName(card)` and raw target objects.
- `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeCallbackHandler.java:2550` does not special-case `StackAbilityView`, so triggered abilities fall back to the generic display name `Ability`.
- `puppeteer/src/puppeteer/decision_renderer.py:271` renders target dicts with `str(t)`, producing the noisy `{'name': 'Gem3P Coach (you)', 'id': 'p2'}` text.
- `Mage.Client.Observer/src/main/java/mage/client/observer/ObserverGamePanel.java:2041` and `Mage.Client.Observer/src/main/java/mage/client/observer/ObserverGamePanel.java:2434` already show the richer serialization we want: source card plus ability text.

Suggested fix:
Reuse the observer/export stack naming logic for bridge tool payloads, and render targets as readable names instead of Python dict reprs. `pass_priority` / `get_action_choices` should expose the same source card / ability text context that `get_game_state` and the export already have.
